risk_description: The product contains allergenic fragrances (Linalool, Citronellol, Alpha-isomethyl ionone, Hexyl cinnamal, Limonene and Coumarin), which are not mentioned in the list of ingredients. Failure to mention the presence of an allergenic fragrance in the labelling in leave-on products may cause dermatitis/eczema, or more serious skin reactions in already sensitized persons.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
